method: Learn two marginal contrasts from the second factorial moments of anonymous FIT counts under symmetric balanced mixtures. Historical orientations are fixed. Compare the same finite dependence estimator using fixed assumed rates, learned rates and true rates on identical FIT and held evidence. All arms receive donor-only observations at evaluation. Preset gain and independent drift criteria unchanged. No native training or intake.
criterion: A development signal requires the preset mean Brier gain on the two correlated conditions and the worst-seed drift bound on the independent condition. This source-law diagnostic does not train, evaluate or promote a native model. Zero protected source effects.
